versions.subject: New Rule - Linux - Steganography Unzip Hidden Information From Picture File
versions.detection:
commands:
    type: EXECVE
    a0:
        - unzip
a1:
    - a1|endswith: '.jpg'
    - a1|endswith: '.png'
condition: commands and a1
